item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
3 nitpicks

GOCS Viking and Ulysses sailed to the last known location of KTE-0851-Cetus, and easily found the parathreat. Once there, we fired multiple torpedos at the parathreat. A majority of these torpedoes struck, to no effect.

Personnel Condition:
487 casualties (487 fatalities, 0 injuries)

It sounds like these were some kind of fast attack ship (which would make the most sense considering a secret org would want something fast and possessing lots of firepower) but those tend to have 20-50 crew. Personally I'd change it to something less dramatic like 100-150.

Also, why no injuries? Wouldn't there be at least one dude with a busted hip or something?

Fifth Generation Jet Fighter (8)
Notes: The fighter jets were able to redirect the movements of LTE-0851-Cetus, keeping it from areas designated as major civilian safezones.

Not only is that a overly high number of jets for a secret organization to be able to maintain, but it's kinda wasteful. Surely they'd have a bunch of shitty 80s UAVs?

Concentrated Plasma Cannon Tank (6)

Notes: The plasma streams fired were able to severely damage the scales of LTE-0851-Cetus. The scale damage dealt in this way to LTE-0851-Cetus did not regenerate as quickly as damage by other armaments.

Plasma is a really bad as a weapon.
